profile.name: Kevin Gibran
profile.headline: Software Engineer | Web, Data & AI
about: I build practical software systems with a focus on web development, application engineering, and data-driven solutions.
My work combines software engineering with continuous learning in data integration, mobile development, AI-assisted development, and modern developer tools.

research.narrative: I am interested in building software that solves real-world problems through clean engineering practices, practical system design, data integration, and responsible use of modern AI tools.

focus.name: Software Engineering
focus.description: Designing and building practical web applications with maintainable architecture, clean interfaces, and reliable functionality.

focus.name: Data & Integration
focus.description: Working with relational databases, data processing, ETL workflows, and system integration.

focus.name: AI-Assisted Development
focus.description: Exploring how AI tools can improve software development workflows, problem solving, productivity, and system design.

projects.name: Library Management
projects.summary: An ongoing software project for managing library operations, designed to explore practical application architecture, database management, and user workflows.
